decision: Adopt a partitioned unified subject graph as the primary subject-formation substrate. Preset general cognitive architecture and regions to reduce search time, while forbidding preset concrete cognition or semantic value formulas.
rejected_primary_path: Continue expanding D1-X/Y with separate designer-defined material, knowledge, protection, conflict or opportunity-cost attribution ledgers.
rationale: a completely unstructured graph may require impractical evolutionary time to form useful long-timescale computation
fully separate semantic networks duplicate routing and impose designer cognition
one graph with biased regions permits rapid shaping, cross-region overlap and later architectural variation
interest and decision may overlap on the same graph while causal phase ordering prevents same-tick self-confirmation
